traceability.notes:
docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md specifies a valid-story-reference rule that must verify that @story annotations reference existing .story.md files, enforce project boundaries and security constraints, handle filesystem errors gracefully, integrate with prior annotation format validation, and support configurable story directories and extensions, with clear diagnostics and documentation.
The implementation fulfills all acceptance criteria and detailed requirements: - Core Functionality: valid-story-reference inspects @story lines, enforces .story.md (when required), resolves candidate paths under context.cwd and configured storyDirectories, checks existence via cached filesystem utilities, and reports fileMissing/invalidExtension/invalidPath/fileAccessError appropriately. - Quality Standards: The rule is implemented as a standard ESLint RuleModule with meta, schema, and messages; filesystem operations are centralized in well-factored utilities that are synchronous (as required by ESLint) and fully wrapped in try/catch, never throwing. - Integration: The rule assumes correctly formatted @story annotations (provided by the 005.0 format-validation rule) and only needs to parse the path token, which it does robustly; tests show it cooperating with the rest of the plugin. - User Experience: Error messages are short, specific, and include the offending path and error details where relevant; tests assert the correct messageIds and data payloads. - Error Handling: Filesystem permission and I/O errors are converted into fs-error status and then into fileAccessError diagnostics, with multiple tests mocking EACCES/EIO ensuring graceful handling without throwing. - Documentation: docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md provides a clear specification of path resolution, project boundary behavior, configuration options, and examples that align directly with the story’s Implementation Notes and examples.
Given the concrete implementation, comprehensive targeted tests that all pass, and aligned documentation, Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION is fully implemented and passes its specification.
